bounded_question: What does the node #115 compaction-stats dump routine 0x5ef66e0 emit end-to-end, and how does each of its sections contribute to the output?

census.method: Exhaustive E8 (call) / E9 (jmp) rel32 scan over every executable PT_LOAD segment, each candidate confirmed by disassembling its containing FDE; stored qwords are 8-byte little-endian occurrences mapped through the PT_LOAD headers; RELATIVE relocations listed from readelf -r. See census.py; committed output is callers.tsv and relocations.txt.
census.summary: main 0x5ef66e0: 3 direct callers, 0 tail jumps; filler 0x5ef1fa0: 2 callers; sibling_1d60 0x5ef1d60: 1 caller; sibling_6280 0x5ef6280: 2 callers; insert_170 0x5eed170: 2 callers; insert_a0 0x5eed0a0: 4 callers; lower_bound_db 0x5eecdb0: 3 callers; lower_bound_f20 0x5eecf20: 2 callers; tree_free_cc0 0x5eebcc0: 13 callers (incl. self-recursion); tree_free_510 0x5eec510: 7 callers (incl. self-recursion); tree_free_590 0x5eec590: 11 callers (incl. self-recursion); str_assign 0x5eebd00: 117 callers; str_b20 0x5eebb20: 20 callers; getter_3570 0x5dd3570: 10 callers; sum_s 0x5f6c300: 4 callers; sum_vec 0x5da4de0: 5 callers + 1 tail jump (0x5f6c316); parse_u64 0x61d1540: 12 callers + 1 tail jump (0x61d1ef4); key_total_stops 0x5fc9ed0: 2 callers; key_total_delays 0x5fc9f80: 2 callers; header_formatter 0x5eedda0: 2 callers; data_row_formatter 0x5eed6f0: 4 callers; outer_insert 0x5ef1630: 4 callers; snapshot_consumer 0x5eefda0: 2 callers; final 0x5ef5d40: 3 callers; priority_name 0x5fcebc0: 2 callers; map_find_insert 0x5ef40a0: 14 callers; inner_insert 0x5ef1480: 21 callers (all inside outer_insert); str_assign_lit 0x5fcd890: 24 callers; tree_copy 0x5eebe10: 3 callers. No pinned address has a RELATIVE relocation record or a stored qword outside .rela.dyn.

corrections.finding: Wrong. A fresh objdump of filler 0x5ef22a2..0x5ef2329 shows: test %edx,%edx (edx = level index i); je 0x5ef22ee skips ONLY the reload of the denominator from L+0x20+L+0x10. rax remains rsp+0x48 = owner+0x90 + owner+0x98 (loaded at 0x5ef20c0..0x5ef20d0); the division still runs when that sum is nonzero, and the rsp+0x8 ratio slot is not overwritten before the outer_insert call at 0x5ef23b4 (xmm2 = ratio confirmed at 0x5ef2390). So the level-0 ratio is (L0+0x30 + L0+0x28) / (owner+0x90 + owner+0x98) when the denominator is nonzero, else 0.0. #3164's "sum_denominator" record (owner+0x90 + owner+0x98) is consistent with this. The model in this PR implements the corrected rule and tests it explicitly.
corrections.target: Open PR #3164, records.json and tools/compaction_consumer_a010_115.py ratio_for_level: "0.0 for level 0"

corrections.finding: Each %lu section does sub $0x8,%rsp before the snprintf call, so the literal 0x60/0x68/0x70(%rsp) operand reads are frame+0x68/+0x70/+0x78, i.e. owner+0xa0/+0xa8/+0xb0. A literal reading of the offsets would mis-attribute the counters by one slot.
corrections.target: The AddFile %lu lines in the dump routine

digit_pair_table.note: The table is assembled by store offset, not load order. The last chunk is stored unaligned at offset 185: its first 7 bytes overwrite the tail of the previous chunk with identical bytes, and its next 8 bytes are the final "96979899". The assembled 200 bytes are the two-digit strings "00".."99" in order.

filler.accumulation: Lane-wise into the Sum struct (rbx = snapshot): paddq lanes +0x00/+0x10/+0x20/+0x30/+0x40/+0x50, scalar +0x60 (u64), +0x68 (i32), paddd lanes +0x6c/+0x7c/+0x8c/+0x9c/+0xac. Bytes 0xbc..0xbf are not accumulated.
filler.doubles_array: new double[nlevels], zeroed; for i in 0..*(src+0x10)-2: D[src_idx[i]] = src_doubles[i] where src_idx = src+0xf50 (int array), src_doubles = src+0xf38
filler.flagged_counts: new int[nlevels], zeroed; counts[i] = number of elements in level i's vector (src+0xa98 + i*24, begin/end pair) whose object has byte +0xb4 != 0
filler.ratio: Numerator = (L+0x30+L+0x28). Denominator = (L+0x20+L+0x10) when i != 0, else owner+0x90+owner+0x98 (rsp+0x48). Ratio = numerator/denominator as doubles (u64-to-double fixup) when the denominator is nonzero, else 0.0.
filler.skip_rule: Skip a level when its first 16 bytes are both zero AND its element count is 0. Its elem/flagged counts still join the Sum totals (accumulated before the skip test); its S and dense do not.
filler.sum_node: Key -1 after the loop: outer_insert with elem/flagged = summed totals (i32), S = summed S, dense = 0.0, ratio = 0.0 when (owner+0x90+owner+0x98)==0 else (snap+0x30+snap+0x28)/(owner+0x90+owner+0x98); level struct = accumulated snapshot; inserted into the outer map the same way (0x5eed0a0 path at 0x5ef262e for the -1 key, then 0x5eecdb0/0x5eebcc0).
filler.sum_s: S_i = 0x5f6c300(src, i), which tail-jumps to 0x5da4de0 with rdi = src+0xa98 + i*24: sum over non-null elements e of level i's vector of *(e+0x10) as i64 (FDE 0x5da4de0..0x5da4e1e, 62 bytes). Accumulated into rsp+0x10 (S total) with u64-to-double fixup when negative.

blob.format: Blob file count: %zu, total size: %.1f GB, garbage size: %.1f GB, space amp: %.1f

cumulative_compaction.format: Cumulative compaction: %.2f GB write, %.2f MB/s write, %.2f GB read, %.2f MB/s read, %.1f seconds

interval_compaction.format: Interval compaction: %.2f GB write, %.2f MB/s write, %.2f GB read, %.2f MB/s read, %.1f seconds

helpers.role: map<int, map<int,double>> insert-or-find with hint: allocates a 0x58-byte node (key int at +0x20, empty inner map at +0x28, header at +0x30), calls 0x5eecf20 (lower_bound with hint), inserts via _Rb_tree_insert_and_rebalance or frees the new node and returns the existing one.
Twin of 0x5eed170 (same shape, also a 0x58-byte node); used for the priority map and the Sum -1 key.
_Rb_tree lower_bound/insert-position with a hint node; uses _Rb_tree_increment/_Rb_tree_decrement PLT helpers; on out-of-range keys tail-jumps to 0x5eeb850.
_Rb_tree copy-assign: clears dst's tree (0x5eebcc0) and copies src's tree via 0x5eebe10.
Recursive free of 0x30-byte map<int,double> nodes (right child via self-recursion, then _ZdlPvm 0x30).
Tree destroy for 0x58-byte nodes: frees inner 0x30-node trees via 0x5eebcc0, then the 0x58 node, then iterates left siblings. Called in the dump caller on rsp+0xd0 and rsp+0xa0.
Twin of 0x5eec510; called in sibling 0x5ef6280 on rsp+0x40.
std::string assign from const char* (used for the Level/Sum/Int/Priority label assigns).
std::string move-assign between two string objects (SSO/heap aware).
Tiny getter: returns *(rdi+0x10) + 0x3e.
Tail-jumps to 0x5da4de0 with rdi = src+0xa98 + level*24 (the filler's per-level S).
Sum over the non-null elements of a level's vector of *(element+0x10) as i64.
Decimal-string -> u64 parser (takes a char**, strlen + __isoc23_strtoull base 10 with errno handling).
Guarded function-local static std::string initializer returning "total-stops" (11 chars, at 0x6504900).
Guarded function-local static std::string initializer returning "total-delays" (12 chars, at 0x65048c0).
Compaction-stats table header formatter (pinned in PR #3180: the 21-column row and dash underline).
Per-level data-row formatter (pinned in PR #3189: 21 metric fields, four call sites in this routine).
Builds the 21-field inner map for one level struct (pinned in PR #3164).
helpers.signature: outer_insert(map=rdi, src=rsi, flagged=edx, level=rcx, s=xmm0, dense=xmm1, ratio=xmm2)

helpers.role: Stats-snapshot consumer (pinned in PR #3082: Block-cache dump, human-size formatting, entry table).
Final/summary consumer filling the map<string,string> the stall sibling renders (pinned in PR #3164).

Assigns the priority name into the label string via 0x5fcd890 and returns the string pointer in rax. Dispatch: 0 -> "Bottom" (0x44fd1a), 1 -> "Low" (0x43a5d9), 2 -> "High" (0x4409fd), 3 -> "User" (0x4487bb), else -> "Invalid" (0x432082).
map<string,string> find-or-insert returning the value slot (used by sibling 0x5ef6280 for the total-stops/total-delays lookups).
Inserts one (key, double) entry into a map<int,double> (called 21 times inside outer_insert 0x5ef1630).
std::string assign from a literal (used by priority_name for the five name literals).
_Rb_tree copy (used by copy-assign 0x5eecdb0).

metric_fields.note: For one 192-byte level struct L (i64 fields unless noted) with (elem_count, flagged_count, S, dense, ratio). All i64->double conversions use the u64-to-double fixup (t=(v>>1)|(v&1), convert, double) when the high bit is set.
metric_fields.source: outer_insert 0x5ef1630, pinned in PR #3164 (records.json there); re-shipped here as outer_insert.txt

not_claimed: No cargo/rustc, git-lfs or Ghidra is available on this VM, so make verify / make test / make catalogue-check cannot be run here; the packet's own verify.py and the model tests are the verification run, and they pass. Hosted CI results are not claimed.

The 21 metric formulas are re-shipped from PR #3164's records (outer_insert.txt is byte-identical to #3164's); they are re-derived here only through the shared excerpt and the census, not re-derived from scratch.

owner_layout.0x128: mutex holder pointer (snapshot consumer section runs only when non-null)
owner_layout.0x618..0x6d8: previous filler snapshot (188 bytes) + previous flush/addfile counters
owner_layout.0x788: stats source pointer (+0x08 = name, +0x30 = blob vector, +0x5a8 = alternate-entry flag)

routine.direct_caller_notes: Three tiny wrapper/thunk functions immediately after the routine (FDEs 0x5ef8050..0x5ef8174, 0x5ef8180..0x5ef819c, 0x5ef81a0..0x5ef81cb). They are not modelled here; the dump routine itself is the bounded unit.
routine.frame: sub $0xca8,%rsp; char buffer at rsp+0x4c0 (2024 bytes, 2000-byte snprintf budget); label string at rsp+0x2b0; outer map<int, map<int,double>> at rsp+0x90 (header rsp+0x98); filler snapshot (188 bytes) at rsp+0x130; aggregate struct (192 bytes) at rsp+0x1f0; per-priority map at rsp+0xc0

sections.behavior: Assign the label string "Level" (rodata 0x44d03d) via 0x5eebd00, format the header row with the header formatter 0x5eedda0 (name = *(owner+0x788)+0x08), append the buffer to out.
sections.name: Level header

sections.behavior: Call the filler 0x5ef1fa0(owner, src=owner+0x788+0x30+0x40, out_map=&rsp+0x90, snapshot=&rsp+0x130), which fills the outer map and the 188-byte snapshot.
sections.name: Filler call

sections.behavior: For i in 0..owner+0x778-1: inlined _Rb_tree lower_bound for key i in the outer map; if found, insert-or-find via 0x5eed170, build the label "L<i>" with the inlined digit-pair-table decimal conversion, call the data-row formatter 0x5eed6f0(buffer, label, inner_map), append the buffer to out. A missing key skips the row.
sections.name: Per-level rows

sections.behavior: lower_bound for key -1, label "Sum" (rodata 0x43f948), data-row formatter, append.
sections.name: Sum row

sections.behavior: Build a 192-byte aggregate struct = lane-wise (filler snapshot - previous snapshot at owner+0x618..0x6d8); label "Int" (rodata 0x441a38); outer_insert a temp map at rsp+0xc0 with elem=0, flagged=0, S=0.0, dense=0.0, ratio=(agg+0x30+agg+0x28)/(1 + flush_interval + addfile_interval) where flush_interval = owner+0x90-owner+0x6d8 and addfile_interval = owner+0x98-owner+0x708; data-row formatter; free the temp tree via 0x5eebcc0; append.
sections.name: Int aggregate row

sections.behavior: Call sibling_1d60(owner, &map@rsp+0xc0), which fills the per-priority map.
sections.name: Sibling 0x5ef1d60 call

sections.behavior: For p in 0..(owner+0x158-owner+0x150)/192-1 (bound computed as ((end-begin)>>6) * 0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaab mod 2^64, i.e. /192 since elements are 192 bytes): lower_bound for key p in the priority map; if found, insert-or-find via 0x5eed0a0, priority_name(p) assigns the name into the label string, data-row formatter, append. A missing key skips the row.
sections.name: Per-priority rows

sections.behavior: Iterate the vector at *(owner+0x788)+0x30, +0xb18/+0xb20 begin/end of 16-byte element pointers; per element: total += 0x5dd3570(*elem) = *(*(elem)+0x10) + 0x3e; garbage += *(elem+0x50). Then snprintf with the blob format: count=(end-begin)/16, total_gb=u64_to_double(total)*2^-30, garbage_gb=u64_to_double(garbage)*2^-30, space_amp = total/(total-garbage) when garbage < total else 0.0.
sections.name: Blob totals

sections.behavior: now = (*(*(owner+0x780)))[0x98](); total_secs = (now - owner+0x790)/1e6; interval_secs = total_secs - owner+0x700 (double field). snprintf with the uptime format. rsp+0x48 = total_secs, rsp+0x20 = interval_secs.
sections.name: Virtual clock call + uptime line

sections.behavior: Five snprintf lines: Flush(GB) cumulative owner+0x90*2^-30, interval (owner+0x90-owner+0x6d8)*2^-30; AddFile(GB) cumulative owner+0x98*2^-30, interval (owner+0x98-owner+0x708)*2^-30; AddFile(Total Files) cumulative owner+0xa0, interval owner+0xa0-owner+0x710; AddFile(L0 Files) owner+0xa8/-owner+0x718; AddFile(Keys) owner+0xb0/-owner+0x720. NOTE: each %lu section does sub $0x8,%rsp first, so the literal 0x60/0x68/0x70(%rsp) reads are frame+0x68/+0x70/+0x78, i.e. owner+0xa0/+0xa8/+0xb0, not the literal offsets.
sections.name: Flush/AddFile lines

sections.behavior: Over owner+0x138 + level*0xc0 (192-byte structs, count owner+0x778): rbx = sum of L+0x00; rbp = sum of (L+0x10+L+0x18+L+0x20) (read total); r13 = sum of (L+0x28+L+0x30) (write total). Cumulative compaction line with (write_gb = r13*2^-30, write_mbps = (r13*2^-20)/uptime_total, read_gb = rbp*2^-30, read_mbps = (rbp*2^-20)/uptime_total, secs = rbx/1e6); interval line with the same five values computed from interval sums (r13-owner+0x6e8, rbp-owner+0x6f0, rbx-owner+0x6f8) divided by interval_secs (rsp+0x20). When an uptime is below 0.001 the MB/s divisor is 0.001 instead (branches at 0x5ef7d4a and 0x5ef7d5b). If nlevels <= 0 the sums are all zero (branch 0x5ef7f1e).
sections.name: Level-array sums + compaction lines

sections.behavior: If the bool arg (esi, saved at rsp+0x44) is nonzero: owner+0x6e8 = r13, owner+0x6f0 = rbp, owner+0x6f8 = rbx.
sections.name: Update branch 1

sections.behavior: Call sibling_6280(owner, out_str=&rsp+0xf0 string, &stall_sum@rsp+0x78); append the returned string to out with a length bounds check.
sections.name: Sibling 0x5ef6280 call

sections.behavior: If the bool arg is nonzero: copy the filler snapshot (rsp+0x130..0x1dc, 188 bytes) into owner+0x618..0x6d8; owner+0x6d8 = owner+0x90; owner+0x700 = uptime total (rsp+0x48); owner+0x708 = (owner+0x98, owner+0xa0); owner+0x718 = (owner+0xa8, owner+0xb0); owner+0x6e0 = stall sum (rsp+0x78).
sections.name: Update branch 2

sections.behavior: If owner+0x128 (mutex holder) is non-null: lock pthread_mutex, copy the 0x148-byte snapshot struct from owner+0x128+0x28..0x158 region to stack at rsp+0x2b0, unlock, call snapshot consumer 0x5eefda0(out_str=&rsp+0x110, snapshot=&rsp+0x2b0, owner+0x780), append, dispose. If the consumer's returned length exceeds 0x141dd75fff the append is skipped (branch 0x5ef7aeb).
sections.name: Snapshot-consumer section

sections.behavior: Dispose strings; tree-free 0x5eec510 on rsp+0xd0 (Int temp map root) and rsp+0xa0 (outer map root); stack-canary check; ret. The remaining tail lines (0x5ef7b3e..0x5ef8049) are u64-to-double fixup blocks, the digit-count dispatch for the "L<i>" label, the length-error/system-error throw paths (__throw_length_error/__throw_system_error, rodata 0x4474d2), and landing pads.
sections.name: Cleanup

sibling_1d60.behavior: Iterate owner+0x150..0x158 vector of 192-byte structs (count = (end-begin)/192 via the /64-then-magic-x-0xAA...AB trick); skip elements whose first qword is 0; else build a fresh temp map<int,double> at rsp+0x20 and call outer_insert(temp, elem=0, flagged=0, struct=elem, S=0.0, dense=0.0, ratio=0.0), then insert-or-find into the prio map under key = index via 0x5eed0a0, copy-assign via 0x5eecdb0, free temp tree via 0x5eebcc0.

sibling_6280.behavior: Calls the final/summary consumer 0x5ef5d40(owner, out_map=&rsp+0x30), which fills a map<string,string>. Builds an ostringstream at rsp+0x80; writes the header "Write Stall (count): " (rodata 0x44de6c, 21 chars); iterates the map in order writing per entry "<key>: <value>, " (key = node+0x20/+0x28, ": " rodata 0x44cfa7, value = node+0x40/+0x48, ", " rodata 0x4360a5). If rdx is non-null: key1 = 0x5fc9ed0() -> function-local static std::string "total-stops" (11 chars, at 0x6504900); key2 = 0x5fc9f80() -> "total-delays" (12 chars, at 0x65048c0); look each up in the summary map via 0x5ef40a0 (map_find_insert); parse each found string value to u64 via 0x61d1540 (takes a char**, strlen + __isoc23_strtoull base 10 with errno handling); sum the two; store the sum to *rdx. If the sum != 0, append "interval: " (rodata 0x43c575, 10 chars) + (sum - owner+0x6e0 as unsigned, via ostream::operator<<) + " total count\n" (rodata 0x433107, 13 chars). Converts the ostringstream to a string via 0x5eebb20 (std::string move-assign) into the out string and returns.
sibling_6280.direct_caller_notes: The second caller 0x5ef65ea is a tiny thunk (FDE 0x5ef65e0..0x5ef65f9) immediately before sibling_6280's own FDE.

spot_check.method: verify.py picks three instruction lines at random (random.Random(66)) from the committed excerpts and verifies each byte-for-byte against a fresh objdump run on the real binary. The pre-submit self-check also re-verified the level-0 ratio correction (filler.txt 0x5ef22e2..0x5ef2329) against a fresh objdump.

unknowns: Alternate filler path: when the byte at (owner+0x788)+0x5a8 == 2, the filler takes an alternate entry (0x5ef272a: count = owner+0x778, ebp = 1). It is not fully modelled (per #3164).
The virtual call at 0x5ef743d uses slot +0x98 of the vtable at *(owner+0x780); the concrete callee behind that slot is not pinned here.
The snapshot-consumer append guard 0x141dd75fff (branch at 0x5ef7aeb): the exact meaning of the compared value (the consumer's returned length) is recorded as observed, not as a pinned semantic.
owner+0x700 (previous uptime total) is read in this routine but never written here; the writer is elsewhere.

The three tiny wrapper callers of the dump routine (0x5ef8050..0x5ef8174, 0x5ef8180..0x5ef819c, 0x5ef81a0..0x5ef81cb) and the tiny thunk caller of sibling 0x5ef6280 (0x5ef65e0..0x5ef65f9) are not modelled; only their call sites are recorded.
The strtoull error paths in parse_u64 0x61d1540 (errno, overflow clamp) are modelled only on the well-formed path; the model clamps at 2^64-1 on overflow.
